title: Administration
householdsHint: Application administrators can view household details. Only members can access financial data.
name: Name
eventsHint: Sign-ins, authentication settings and administrator actions. Secrets are never recorded.
signInHint: At least one sign-in method must remain enabled.
localForced: Enabled by AUTH_FORCE_LOCAL_LOGIN for emergency access.
linkSsoFirst: Link SSO to your account before disabling password sign-in to keep access.
configureSsoFirst: Set up and enable SSO before disabling password sign-in.
registrationHint: Off by default. New users can join by invitation only.
resetEnabled: Password reset by e-mail is enabled (SMTP configured).
resetDisabled: SMTP is not configured. Reset passwords on the Users tab.
ratesHint: Source: {source}. Rates are shared across households. A manual rate takes priority for the same date.
sourceCbr: Bank of Russia, cached in the database
refreshHint: For a past date, loads the selected currency’s preceding 14 days of history. For today, loads all latest rates.
noRates: No exchange rates yet. Refresh rates or enter one manually.
telegramHint: Create a bot with @BotFather. Its token is stored encrypted. Tests go to the current administrator’s Telegram account linked in their profile.
botEnv: The token is set via TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN. Mode: {mode}. Environment settings take priority.
keepToken: Leave blank to keep the current token
pushHint: The private VAPID key is stored encrypted. Reconnect browsers after rotating keys.
deliveryHint: Names, addresses, household names and message content are excluded. An unknown status means the delivery outcome is unclear and retries are disabled.
oidcHint: Keycloak, Authentik, Microsoft Entra ID and other OIDC providers. The secret is stored encrypted.
oidcEnv: The provider is configured via OIDC_* environment variables, which take priority over UI settings. Remove OIDC_ISSUER from the environment to manage SSO here.
ssoSignup: Create accounts on first SSO sign-in
ssoSignupHint: When off, new users need an invitation to sign in with SSO. Existing accounts are never linked automatically by e-mail.
userCount: Total: {count, number}. New users join by invitation, SSO or public registration.
temporaryPasswordHint: Share it securely and ask the user to change it after signing in. It is shown only once.
blockHint: The user will be unable to sign in and active sessions will end. Their data will be kept.
resetHint: A temporary password will be created and all the user’s sessions will end.
